residentialProxy.title: Static Residential Proxy
descriptionList: A proxy service based on real residential networks, providing fixed proxy addresses that remain unchanged for long periods.
With high anonymity and credibility, it effectively avoids being identified as a proxy or being blocked,
suitable for cross-border e-commerce, market research, social media marketing, brand protection, and various other business scenarios.

dynamicProxy.title: Dynamic Residential Proxy
descriptionList: A proxy service based on a constantly changing proxy address pool, providing proxy addresses that change frequently within short periods.
This service offers high flexibility and extensive proxy coverage, effectively avoiding proxy bans and restrictions,
suitable for scenarios requiring frequent proxy changes such as web scraping, data collection, ad verification, and automated testing.

dataCenterProxy.title: Static Data Center Proxy
descriptionList: A proxy service based on data center networks, providing fixed proxy addresses that remain unchanged for long periods.
This proxy service delivers proxies through data center servers, typically offering high speed and stability, with advantages in cost and performance.
Particularly suitable for business scenarios requiring fast, large-scale data scraping and access, such as website testing, data analysis, SEO monitoring, and online ad verification.

items.title: How do IP proxies work?
items.description: IP proxies act as intermediary servers that hide your real IP address, helping you access geo-restricted content while providing additional security and anonymity protection.

items.title: What's the difference between static residential IPs and dynamic proxies?
items.description: Static residential proxies are fixed, real residential IP addresses ideal for businesses requiring stable IPs, while dynamic proxies automatically rotate periodically, perfect for data collection tasks requiring frequent IP changes.

items.title: How is IPFlex's proxy IP service priced?

items.title: How to choose the right proxy IP type?
